skill.name: MATLAB
skill.description: Avoid common MATLAB mistakes — indexing traps, matrix vs element-wise ops, and vectorization pitfalls.
skill.summary: Indexing - 1-based indexing — first element is `A(1)`, not `A(0)` - `end` keyword for last index — `A(end)`, `A(end-1)`, works in any dimension - Linear indexing on matrices — `A(5)` accesses 5th element column-major ord
